title.narrative: Lebanon’s compounded crisis is severely impacting child nutrition and development, with growing triple burden of malnutrition and developmental deficits. LIMA survey highlights alarming child malnutrition and developmental deficits. UNICEF focused on multi-system approaches promoting adequate diets, caregiving practices and services for prevention of all forms of malnutrition and developmental deficits.;;
